e1 <- readRDS(here(object_dir, "e1.Rds"))

e4 <- readRDS(here(object_dir, "e4.Rds"))

Tree mortality

Count of dead and ‘healthy’ (not dead) trees summarised per plot (or per subplot for experiment 3).

Binomial GLM fit to mortality matrix with Firth-type bias reduction.

mortalityByPlot <- function(data, timepoint = "T2") {
  data[timepoint == timepoint & !is.na(health)][
    , .(dead = sum(health == "dead"), total = .N),
    by = .(plot, block, duration, experiment, treatment)
  ][, mortality := dead / total]
}


# E1

model <- glm(
  cbind(dead, total - dead) ~ block + duration,
  data   = mortalityByPlot(e1[duration != "8"], "T3"),
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  method = brglmFit # Firth-type bias reduction
)
# check_model(model) # fine
# sim <- simulate_residuals(model)
# testResiduals(sim)
# testZeroInflation(sim)

summary(model)
## 
## Call:
## glm(formula = cbind(dead, total - dead) ~ block + duration, family = binomial(link = "logit"), 
##     data = mortalityByPlot(e1[duration != "8"], "T3"), method = brglmFit)
## 
## Deviance Residuals: 
##     Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max  
## -2.6324  -1.1565   0.2192   0.5869   1.0091  
## 
## Coefficients:
##             Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
## (Intercept)  -2.8957     0.5340  -5.422 5.89e-08 ***
## block2        0.2350     0.4841   0.485    0.627    
## block3        0.3380     0.4759   0.710    0.478    
## block4       -0.6658     0.5974  -1.114    0.265    
## block5       -0.9443     0.6467  -1.460    0.144    
## duration1     0.9825     0.5182   1.896    0.058 .  
## duration2     0.4643     0.5564   0.835    0.404    
## duration4     0.6954     0.5370   1.295    0.195

## 
## (Dispersion parameter for binomial family taken to be 1)

##     Null deviance: 34.523  on 19  degrees of freedom
## Residual deviance: 22.447  on 12  degrees of freedom
## AIC:  76.463

## Type of estimator: AS_mixed (mixed bias-reducing adjusted score equations)
## Number of Fisher Scoring iterations: 4
anova(update(model, . ~ block), model, test = "Chisq")
Anova(model, type = 3)
emmeans(model, trt.vs.ctrl ~ duration, type = "response")

Experiment 3

This model would not converge

DHARMa results fine. Some binned residuals out of bounds.

mortalityByPlotE3 <- function(data, timepoint = "T2") {
  data[timepoint == timepoint & !is.na(health)][
    , .(dead = sum(health == "dead"), total = .N),
    by = .(plot, block, genotype, treatment)
  ][, mortality := dead / total]
}

e3_mortality <- mortalityByPlotE3(e3)


design <- cbind(dead, total - dead) ~ genotype * treatment + (1 | block / genotype)

# model <- glmer(design, data = e3_mortality, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

# model <- glmmTMB(design, ziformula = ~ 0 + treatment, data = e3_mortality, family = betabinomial(link = "logit"))

# check_model(model) # High collinearity

VarCorr(model)

mortalityPlot <- function(data, timepoint = "T2") {
  ggerrorplot(
    data = mortalityByPlot(data, timepoint = "T2")[, mortality := dead / total],
    x = "duration",
    y = "mortality",
    add = "jitter",
    desc_stat = "mean_ci"
  )
}

# emmeans error plot
emmMortalityPlot <- function(data, x, emm, facet = NULL, xlab = "Waterlogging treatment") {
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_jitter(
      data = data,
      aes(x = get(x), y = mortality),# colour = block),
      width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.4, size = 2
    ) +
    geom_pointrange(
      data = emm,
      aes(x = get(x), y = prob, ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL),
      fatten = 1.8, size = 1
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Mortality") +
    guides(colour = "none") +
    theme_bw()#(base_size = 12)

    if(!is.null(facet)) p <- p + facet_wrap(~ get(facet))

    p
}

# Remove pots with 2 or more dead or missing trees
remove_dead_pots <- function(data) {
  pots_to_remove <- unique(data[
    health == "dead" | health == "missing", .N, by = .(pot, timepoint)
  ][N >= 2, .(pot)])

  cat(
    "Removed", nrow(pots_to_remove),
    "pots with 2 or more dead or missing trees\n\n"
  )

  data[!.(pots_to_remove), on = .(pot)]
}

Growth

#' @title Summarise growth data
#'
summarise_growth <- function(data, measurement, trt_var, remove_health = NULL) {
  # Check columns
  if (!all(c(
    "timepoint", trt_var, measurement
  ) %in% colnames(data))) {
    stop("Input data does not contain required columns.")
  }

  # Summarise data by measurement
  data[
    !is.na(get(measurement)) & !(health %in% remove_health),
    .(
      mean = mean(get(measurement), na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(get(measurement), na.rm = TRUE),
      N = .N,
      sd = sd(get(measurement), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    by = c("timepoint", "plot", trt_var)
  ]#[, get(trt_var) := factor(get(trt_var))]
}

#' @title Plot growth data
#'
plot_growth <- function(data, measurement, treatment) {
  units <- if (measurement == "diameter") {
    "mm"
  } else if (measurement == "height") {
    "cm"
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  ggline(
    data,
    x = "timepoint",
    y = "mean",
    color = "plot",
    facet.by = treatment
  ) +
    labs(
      title = measurement, #paste(measurement, "by Treatment"),
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = paste0(measurement, " (", units, ")")
    ) +
    guides(colour = "none")
}

Growth rate

growth_rate <- function(data, by, final = "T3") {
  # Filter data for T1 and T3 timepoints
  data_subset <- data[timepoint %in% c("T1", final)]

  # Remove height data for broken trees
  broken <- unique(data_subset[health %in% c("top_broken", "top_dead"), get(by)])
  data_subset[get(by) %in% broken, height := NA]

  # Identify factor columns
  factor_cols <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.factor)]
  factor_cols <- factor_cols[!factor_cols %in% c("timepoint", "height")]

  # Calculate growth rate for height
  height_growth <- data_subset[
    ,
    .(
      initial_height = height[timepoint == "T1"],
      final_height = height[timepoint == final]
    ),
    by = by
  ][, `:=`(
    height_absolute = final_height - initial_height,
    height_relative = (final_height - initial_height) / initial_height,
    height_relative_ln = log(final_height / initial_height)
  )]

  # Calculate growth rate for diameter
  diameter_growth <- data_subset[
    ,
    .(
      initial_diameter = diameter[timepoint == "T1"],
      final_diameter = diameter[timepoint == final]
    ),
    by = by
  ][, `:=`(
    diameter_absolute = final_diameter - initial_diameter,
    diameter_relative = (final_diameter - initial_diameter) / initial_diameter,
    diameter_relative_ln = log(final_diameter / initial_diameter)
  )]

  # Retain factor columns
  factor_data <- unique(data_subset[, .SD, .SDcols = unique(c(by, factor_cols))], by = by)

  # Merge height and diameter growth rates
  growth_data <- merge(height_growth, diameter_growth, by = by, all = TRUE)
  merge(factor_data, growth_data, by = by, all.x = TRUE)
}

Diameter

#' Pivot growth
pivotGrowth <- function(data, pivot, values = c("diameter", "height")) {
  dcast(data, pivot, value.var = values)[, experiment := data$experiment[[1]]]
}

#' Remove negative growth measurements (likely measurement error)
clean_growth <- function(dt) {
  # Metrics can be diameter or height (or extension_mean in E4)
  metrics <- unique(sub("_T[0-9]$", "", grep("_T[0-9]$", names(dt), value = TRUE)))
  for (m in metrics) {
    t1 <- paste0(m, "_T1"); t2 <- paste0(m, "_T2"); t3 <- paste0(m, "_T3")

    # If T2 < T1, set T2 to NA
    if (all(c(t1, t2) %in% names(dt))) dt[get(t2) < get(t1), (t2) := NA]

    # If T3 < T2, set T3 to NA
    if (all(c(t2, t3) %in% names(dt))) dt[get(t3) < get(t2), (t3) := NA]

    # If T3 < T1, set T3 to NA (ensuring non-decreasing from baseline)
    if (all(c(t1, t3) %in% names(dt))) dt[get(t3) < get(t1), (t3) := NA]
  }
  dt
}

Growth plots

growthByPlot <- function(data, t1, t2, x) {
  cols <- c(x, "block", "plot", if ("genotype" %in% colnames(data)) "genotype")
  data[!is.na(get(t2))][, .(T1 = mean(get(t1)), T2 = mean(get(t2))), cols]
}

# growthByPlot(e1_growth, "diameter_T1", "diameter_T2", "duration")


growthSlopePlot <- function(
  data, type, x, emm, final = "T2", facet = NULL, xlab = "Waterlogging treatment"
) {
  T1 <- paste0(type, "_T1")
  T2 <- paste0(type, "_", final)
  dat <- growthByPlot(data, T1, T2, x)

  levels <- unique(dat[[x]]) |> sort()

  dat <- mutate(
    dat,
    dur_idx = as.numeric(get(x)),
    x_T1    = dur_idx - 0.4,
    x_T2    = dur_idx + 0.4
  )

  emm <- emm %>% mutate(
    dur_idx = as.numeric(get(x)),
    x       = dur_idx,
    x_T2    = dur_idx + 0.5
  )

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = dat,
      aes(x = x_T1, xend = x_T2, y = T1, yend = T2),# colour = block),
      size = 0.4, alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_point(data = dat, aes(x = x_T1, y = T1), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_point(data = dat, aes(x = x_T2, y = T2), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_pointrange(
      data = emm,
      aes(x = x, y = emmean, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
      size = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(0:(length(levels) - 1)),
      labels = levels,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.08))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = xlab,
      y = if (type == "diameter") "Diameter (mm)" else if (type == "height") "Height (cm)"
    ) +
    # theme(legend.position = "none") +
    guides(colour = "none") +
    theme_bw()
  
  # E4 plot angle text
  # if (data$treatment[[1]] == "4 weeks winter") {
  if (data$experiment[[1]] == "E4") {
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 10, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
  }

  if (!is.null(facet)) {
    facet_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", facet))
    p <- p + facet_wrap(facet_formula)
  }
  p
}


extPlot <- function(data, x, emm) {
  ggplot() +
  geom_jitter(
    data = data[, .(ext = mean(extension_mean)), c(x, "block", "plot")],
    aes(x = get(x), y = ext),# colour = block),
    width = 0.3, height = 0, alpha = 0.2, size = 2
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(
    data = emm,
    aes(x = get(x), y = emmean, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    # fatten = 1.8, 
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(x = "Waterlogging treatment", y = "Extension (cm)") +
  guides(colour = "none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 10, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
}

Canker models

Experiment 1

e1_canker_data <- e1[!is.na(inoc_cankers)] |> as.data.frame()

# E1 canker model
# design <- cbind(inoc_cankers, inoc_points - inoc_cankers) ~ duration + (1 | block) + (1 | inoculation),
design <- cbind(inoc_cankers, inoc_points - inoc_cankers) ~ duration + (1 | block / plot / pot) + (1 | inoculation)
e1_canker_model <- glmer(
  design,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  data = e1_canker_data
)

# Check model assumptions
check_model(e1_canker_model)
sim <- simulateResiduals(e1_canker_model)
plot(sim)
testResiduals(sim)
testZeroInflation(sim)

summary(e1_canker_model)
Anova(e1_canker_model, type = 3)
emmeans(e1_canker_model, trt.vs.ctrl ~ duration)

Experiment 2

# E2 data
e2_canker <- e2[!is.na(rasp_cankers) & timepoint == "T2"]

# E2 canker model
y <- cbind(rasp_cankers, rasp_inoculations - rasp_cankers) ~ x
design <- update(y, . ~ duration + (1 | block / plot / pot) + (1 | inoculation))
e2_canker_model <- glmer(design, data = e2_canker, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
d0 <- update(y, ~ (1 | block / plot / pot) + (1 | inoculation))
m0 <- glmer(d0, data = e2_canker, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
# Check model assumptions
check_model(m0)

check_model(e2_canker_model) # poor

sim <- simulateResiduals(e2_canker_model)
plot(sim) # good

testResiduals(sim) # good

## $uniformity
## 
##  Asymptotic one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
## 
## data:  simulationOutput$scaledResiduals
## D = 0.046267, p-value = 0.6006
## alternative hypothesis: two-sided
## 
## 
## $dispersion
## 
##  DHARMa nonparametric dispersion test via sd of residuals fitted vs.
##  simulated
## 
## data:  simulationOutput
## dispersion = 1.1762, p-value = 0.2
## alternative hypothesis: two.sided
## 
## 
## $outliers
## 
##  DHARMa bootstrapped outlier test
## 
## data:  simulationOutput
## outliers at both margin(s) = 0, observations = 274, p-value = 1
## alternative hypothesis: two.sided
##  percent confidence interval:
##  0.00000000 0.00729927
## sample estimates:
## outlier frequency (expected: 0.00164233576642336 ) 
##                                                  0
testDispersion(sim) # good

## 
##  DHARMa nonparametric dispersion test via sd of residuals fitted vs.
##  simulated
## 
## data:  simulationOutput
## dispersion = 1.1762, p-value = 0.2
## alternative hypothesis: two.sided
testZeroInflation(sim) # good

## 
##  DHARMa zero-inflation test via comparison to expected zeros with
##  simulation under H0 = fitted model
## 
## data:  simulationOutput
## ratioObsSim = 1.064, p-value = 0.488
## alternative hypothesis: two.sided
# Summary
# summary(e2_canker_model)
# exp(fixef(e2_canker_model)) # Odds ratios
anova(m0, e2_canker_model, test = "Chisq")
anova(update(e2_canker_model, . ~ (1 | block / plot / pot) + (1 | inoculation)), e2_canker_model)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
Anova(e2_canker_model, type = 3)
emmeans(e2_canker_model, trt.vs.ctrl ~ duration)
## $emmeans
##  duration emmean    SE  df asymp.LCL asymp.UCL
##  Control   -1.74 0.378 Inf     -2.48    -0.997
##  1         -1.51 0.368 Inf     -2.23    -0.788
##  2         -1.41 0.369 Inf     -2.13    -0.683
##  4         -1.82 0.387 Inf     -2.58    -1.061
##  8         -1.74 0.386 Inf     -2.49    -0.981
## 
## Results are given on the logit (not the response) scale. 
## Confidence level used: 0.95 
## 
## $contrasts
##  contrast    estimate    SE  df z.ratio p.value
##  1 - Control  0.22878 0.489 Inf   0.467  0.9413
##  2 - Control  0.33283 0.490 Inf   0.679  0.8612
##  4 - Control -0.08122 0.502 Inf  -0.162  0.9953
##  8 - Control  0.00179 0.499 Inf   0.004  1.0000
## 
## Results are given on the log odds ratio (not the response) scale. 
## P value adjustment: dunnettx method for 4 tests

Canker models - summarise by Plot

E1

cankerSummary <- function(data) {
  cols <- colnames(data)
  id_cols <- intersect(cols, c("block", "plot", "tree", "treatment", "duration"))
  inoc_cols <- intersect(cols, c("inoc_points", "rasp_inoculations", "leaf_scar_inoculations"))
  canker_cols <- intersect(cols, c("cankers", "inoc_cankers",  "rasp_cankers", "leaf_scar_cankers"))
  long <- melt(
    data,
    id.vars = c(id_cols, "timepoint"),
    measure.vars = canker_cols,
    variable.name = "canker_type",
    value.name = "count"
  )
  wide <- dcast(
    long,
    formula = paste(paste(id_cols, collapse = " + "), "~ canker_type + timepoint"),
    value.var = "count"
  )
  wide
  select_cols <- c(id_cols, inoc_cols)
  d <- data[timepoint == "T2", ..select_cols]
  d <- d[complete.cases(d[, ..inoc_cols])]
  result <- merge(d, wide, by = id_cols, all.x = TRUE)
  # Remove columns with all NA values
  # result <- result[, which(!sapply(.SD, function(x) all(is.na(x)))), .SDcols = names(result), with = FALSE]
  cols_to_keep <- names(result)[!sapply(result, function(x) all(is.na(x)))]
  result <- result[, ..cols_to_keep]
  canker_cols_wide <- grep("inoc|cankers", names(result), value = TRUE)
  id_cols_wide <- id_cols[id_cols != "tree"]
  # Summarise per plot
  result[, c(lapply(.SD, sum, na.rm = TRUE), .(n_trees = .N)), by = id_cols_wide, .SDcols = canker_cols_wide]
}

e2_canker <- cankerSummary(e2)

  .(cankers = sum(leaf_scar_cankers), inoc = sum(leaf_scar_inoculations)),
  by = .(plot, block, treatment)
]

# Model
design <- cbind(cankers, inoc - cankers) ~ block + treatment
model <- glm(design, data = e4_ls_canker, family = binomial(link = "logit"), method = brglmFit)

# check_model(model) # fine
# sim <- simulate_residuals(model)
# testResiduals(sim) # fine
# testZeroInflation(sim)

# Results
summary(model)

# Combined canker types
e4_canker <- rbind(
  e4_rasp_canker[, .(plot, block, treatment, cankers, inoc, type = "Rasp wound")],
  e4_ls_canker[, .(plot, block, treatment, cankers, inoc, type = "Leaf scar")]
)

# Binomial GLMM
design <- cbind(cankers, inoc - cankers) ~ type * treatment + (1 | block / plot)
model <- glmer(design, data = e4_canker, family = binomial(link = "logit"))#, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

Canker plots

emmCankerCountPlot <- function(data, x, y, emm, facet = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_jitter(
      data = data,
      aes(x = get(x), y = get(y)),# colour = Treatments),
      # position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.6),
      width = 0.2, height = 0,
      alpha = 0.2, size = 2
    ) +
    geom_pointrange(
      data = emm,
      aes(x = get(x), y = response, ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL),# colour = Treatments),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
      fatten = 1.8, size = 1
    ) +
    labs(x = "Waterlogging duration (weeks)", y = "Total cankers") +
    theme_bw()
  if (!is.null(facet)) p <- p + facet_wrap(facet)
  p
}

  Treatments == "cankers_T3", "repeat"
)][, Treatments := factor(Treatments, levels = c("single", "repeat"))]
e1_canker_emm <- bind_rows(

)[, Treatments := factor(Treatments, levels = c("single", "repeat"))]

e1_canker_plot <- emmCankerCountPlot(e1_canker_long, "duration", "cankers", e1_canker_emm, "Treatments")


emmCankerPlotColour <- function(data, x, emm, xlab, colour, facet = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_jitter(
      data = data,
      aes(x = get(x), y = cankers / inoc, colour = get(colour)),
      position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.6),
      alpha = 0.2, size = 2
    ) +
    geom_pointrange(
      data = emm,
      aes(x = get(x), y = prob, ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL, colour = get(colour)),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
      fatten = 1.8, size = 1
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Canker incidence") +
    theme_bw()
  if (!is.null(facet)) {
    if (length(facet) == 1) p <- p + facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", facet)))
    else p <- p + facet_grid(facet)
  }
  p
}
# emmCankerPlotColour(e2_canker_long, "duration", e2_canker_emm, "Waterlogging duration (weeks)", "Treatments", facet = "wound")


emmCankerPlot <- function(data, x, emm, xlab, facet = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_jitter(
      data = data,
      aes(x = get(x), y = cankers / inoc),
      width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.2, size = 2
    ) +
    geom_pointrange(
      data = emm,
      aes(x = get(x), y = prob, ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL),
      fatten = 1.8, size = 1
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Canker incidence") +
    theme_bw()

  if (!is.null(facet)) {
    if (length(facet) == 1) p <- p + facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", facet)))
    else p <- p + facet_grid(facet)
  }
  
  p
}
